skills: 学习用品词汇：schoolbag / pencil / pencil case / ruler / eraser / book
用途理解（write / read / erase / put in）
帮助同学（Don't worry. Use my ...）
pdf: ../pdf/2026上海一年级英语上册第三单元测试卷_沪教版2024.pdf

sections.title: Listen and circle. 听一听，圈出符合录音的图片
Look and match. 看图，把学习用品和单词连起来
sections.answers: schoolbag、pencil、ruler、book、eraser、pencil case 分别连对应图片。

sections.title: Read and choose. 读一读，选择正确的学习用品
sections.answers: 1A 2B 3A 4A（I write with it.→pencil；I read it.→book；I erase with it.→eraser；I put pencils in it.→pencil case）

sections.title: Pack my schoolbag. 圈出应该装进书包的学习用品
Read and match. 读句子，把表达和情境连起来
sections.answers: Pack my pencil—把铅笔装进书包；Pack my ruler—把直尺装进书包；Don't worry—安慰同学；Use my eraser—把橡皮借给同学。

sections.title: Speaking task. 口语小任务（家长/老师评分）
sections.answers: 能边整理边说出至少4个"Pack my ..."句子即可。

sections.title: Listen and number. 听录音，按顺序给图片编号1-6
Complete the dialogue. 从词语框中选出合适的表达，填序号
Choose the best sentence. 根据情境，选最合适的表达
sections.answers: 1A Pack my ruler. 2B Use my pencil. 3A Don't worry. 4A Pack my books.

sections.title: Look, think and choose. 看图思考，选择正确答案
Mini project. "What do I take to school?" 圈出合适的物品
Speaking challenge. 口语挑战（家长/老师评分）
sections.answers: 能描述整理书包，并在同伴需要时用"Don't worry. Use my ..."提供帮助即可。

usageNotes: 每题听力读两遍。不要求机械默写单词，口语评价优先看能否准确指认物品并用"Pack my ..."完成整理。原卷B卷各题分值合计110分（20+20+20+20+15+15），与卷首"满分100分"不一致；totalScore 按卷首记录。
